notes: New look: everyone is now a Toy Brawler, a chunky robot with a helmet, glowing eyes behind the visor and your team's colors, animated as it runs, jumps, swings and carries the bomb. Bots show off the different helmets, eye styles and body types.
New weapons: three G-Hammers (Maul, Gravity Core, Warhammer) and three E-Swords (Blade, Curved, Cleaver), glowing in your accent color. They only change how weapons look, not how they hit.
